name: Workzura
description: A comprehensive platform featuring public user profiles, gigs, and messaging. Built with a React frontend and a Laravel backend, integrating Reverb workers, MySQL, and secure PayPal webhooks, all deployed on Oracle Cloud via Docker.

name: Atlal
description: Atlal is a traditional Moroccan women's tailoring shop located in Ksar el-Kebir. The website showcases their bespoke services for authentic garments like Djellabas, Caftans, and Takchitas. Built with PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
